change.objective: Create the reusable Lean counting lemma implementing one summand of patternFamily, as required by SourceIndex b_0009/article/sections/02_proof.tex 48–50: if a finite pattern P is disjoint from filler U, the image of U.powersetCard (d + 1 - P.card) under A ↦ P ∪ A has cardinality Nat.choose U.card (d + 1 - P.card). Use Finset.card_powersetCard and Finset.card_image_of_injective, proving injectivity from disjointness. This consumes Mathlib support and serves patternFamily_card_sum and every later star/deleted/inserted pattern count; preserve the exact d+1-P.card index and add no construction-specific hypotheses.
